zeal.desc: Slow to break; fervor rises as comrades fall and banners rally the faithful. They hold their ground, so they take heavier losses.

prof.desc: Steady under artillery and quick to rally near officers; heavy losses sap them more than other armies.

home.desc: Much braver inside their own supply area (near their buildings, depots and supply lines); ordinary soldiers beyond it.

fire.desc: Lowest morale: they break sooner, especially with no armor, artillery or air support nearby. Balanced by stronger fire support and sturdier modern gear.

quarry.name: Quarry
quarry.eff: Pays you steady income, as much as an oil derrick, while you hold it.

mine.name: Mine
mine.eff: Pays you steady income, 30% more than a quarry or an oil derrick, while you hold it.

plant.name: Power plant
plant.eff: Gives you its power on top of your own generators. Lose it and that power is gone.

hosp.name: Field Hospital
hosp.eff: Heals your infantry within 260 m (1.5% of their health every second). Infantry you train come out as veterans (rank 1) while you hold it.

spy.name: Infiltrator
spy.desc: A plain-clothes operative, not a soldier: cap, dark jacket, a satchel on a strap and a phone at the ear - no uniform and no rifle. Hidden from the enemy until it acts or enemy infantry spots it; while it is hidden you see a small eye above it. Unarmed: select it, pick a job, then right-click a target.

bmt.name: Zolfaghar Missile Launcher
bmt.desc: One big guided ballistic missile per launch, from far beyond any gun. Reloads slowly, costs a lot, you can have two. Air defense (missile-defence sites, Iron Dome, flak) can shoot it down in flight. Fragile: hide it behind your lines.

gen.name: Diesel Generator Station
gen.desc: Battle only: makes power for the electronic buildings (air defense, coastal missiles, Strike Center, Radio & TV, Airfield, radar). Not enough power switches them off. Captured map power plants add to it.

coast.name: Noor / Qader Coastal Missiles
coast.desc: Anti-ship missiles for the shore: hits warships, boats and landing craft (and spots submarines nearby), nothing else. Build it on the coast.

radio.name: Radio & TV Station
radio.desc: Not built in Battle (a Conquest building, removed 2026-11-14). Broadcasts to the towns around it: your towns grow more loyal, enemy towns in range grow restless. Unlocks Leaflet Drops on enemy towns. Fragile - bomb the enemy one.

depot.name: Supply Depot
depot.desc: Supply trucks unload here instead of driving back to the HQ. Build one beside a far supply field. Also refills ammo of troops near it.

econ.name: Saffron Bazaar
econ.desc: Earns a slow, steady income: $210 a minute for the first, less for each extra one (max 4). Pays for itself in about 10 minutes.

fort.name: Mountain Fortress
fort.desc: One per player. A rock-cut bunker that works like a tunnel (units go in and come out of any tunnel) but holds 12 more units. Nothing can damage it except a Bunker Buster.
